map.多项式系数和二项式系数什么关系？: How do multinomial and binomial coefficients relate?
map.二项式系数是 m=2 的特例：C(n;k,n−k) = n!/(k!(n−k)!: The binomial coefficient is the special case m=2: C(n;k,n−k) = n!/(k!(n−k)!) = C(n,k). The multinomial coefficient generalizes it to multiple groups.
map.什么时候用多项式系数？: When do you use the multinomial coefficient?
map.当展开式含多于两项（如 (a+b+c)ⁿ）或要把 n 个对象按既定规模分到多个组: Use it when the expansion has more than two terms (e.g. (a+b+c)ⁿ) or when n objects must be split into multiple groups of fixed sizes. Order within groups is ignored and the group sizes are fixed — its typical features.
